title: The Arctic Doomsday Seed Vault Flooded in 2017. The Seeds Were Fine

scenes.text: Deep in an Arctic mountain in Norway, it stores hundreds of thousands of seed samples.
Inside, it's kept at minus 18 degrees Celsius, built to protect crops from disaster.
In 2017, weather about seven degrees warmer than normal melted ice and permafrost.
It never reached the seeds, and the tunnel was waterproofed afterwards.

description:
The doomsday vault flooded.
In 2017 meltwater flooded the entrance tunnel of the Svalbard Global Seed Vault, but the seeds were not damaged.
What would you save in a vault for the future?
first_comment: What one thing would you store in a doomsday vault?
